statement.zh: 哈苏纳 1943–1944 年伊拉克古物局发掘界定了哈苏纳文化序列及相关出土，见 Lloyd & Safar 1945（JNES）。「两河第一村落」留假说栏。
statement.en: At Tell Hassuna, the 1943–1944 Iraqi Directorate excavations defined the Hassuna cultural sequence and associated finds, as documented in Lloyd & Safar 1945 (JNES). “First village in Mesopotamia” claims stay in the hypothesis column.

editorial.notes: Paraphrased from cited registered sources only. | Substance tighten 2026-10-12: Tightened: Hassuna sequence first.
